title: About Your Accounts
subtitle: A section at the bottom of Savings & Reserves explains each savings, retirement and HSA account and the pension, and how each one stays current. One upgrade, then read.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet, and I have written a description for each account. The upgrade adds the section.
**What does not change:** no balances, funds or transactions. The funds table itself looks the same.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before about your accounts 2026-11-14`.
Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.20.0`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload the Sheet.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.done: The report mentions Accounts: added column(s) About This Account.

steps.text: Open **Savings & Reserves** and scroll below the funds table to **About your accounts**. Each account has its balance, when it was last updated, how it stays current, and what it is.
steps.done: Every account shows a description. A row that says "No description yet" has an empty About This Account cell on the Accounts tab.

steps.text: To change any wording, open **Accounts**, scroll to the last column, **About This Account**, and edit the text on that account's row.
steps.note: The section updates on its own. Balances, last-updated dates and how each account stays current always come from the Accounts tab, so they never go stale.
